question: What does the Greek word 'Eucharist' (eucharistia) mean?

teaching.title: Eucharistia — Thanksgiving
teaching.body: 'Eucharistia' (εὐχαριστία) means 'thanksgiving' in Greek, from 'eu' (good) + 'charis' (grace, gift). All four NT accounts of the Last Supper note that Jesus 'gave thanks' (eucharistesas) before breaking the bread (Matt 26:27, Mark 14:23, Luke 22:17-19, 1 Cor 11:24). The Didache (~100 AD) uses 'Eucharist' as a technical term for the sacrament. The name links the Eucharist to Israel's todah (thanksgiving sacrifice) and to the cosmic act of gratitude for redemption.
